question: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy (MAKA) was instituted in year ________ and awarded to the overall top performing Indian University in the Sports.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1956-57**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy **(MAKA) was instituted in the year **1956-57**.
 
• It is awarded annually to the **university **in India that has given the **best all-round performance in sports**.
 
• The trophy is named after Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, the first Minister of Education in independent India, who served from 1947 to 1958.
 
• The award aims to promote competitive sports in the universities and encourage sportsmanship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The MAKA Trophy is a rolling trophy awarded by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India.
 
• It is given to the university that has shown exceptional performance in inter-university tournaments and other sports activities recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).
 
• The universities are judged based on their performance in various sports disciplines including athletics, badminton, basketball, cricket, football, hockey, tennis, and volleyball, among others.
